description: This file contains shared pytest fixtures for testing a FastAPI application with an in-memory SQLite database using StaticPool. It defines fixtures for setting up the test database, client, user registration and authentication, task creation, and repository access, facilitating isolated and repeatable tests for a task management system.

methods.name: Generator[None,None,None] _using_inmemory_db()
methods.description: Context manager that overrides the DATABASE_URL environment variable to use an in-memory SQLite database with StaticPool, resets cache, initializes the database, and ensures a clean schema for tests.

methods.name: Iterable[None] inmemory_db_session_scope()
methods.description: Session-scoped fixture that sets up the in-memory database for all tests during the test session.

methods.name: Generator[TestClient,None,None] client(inmemory_db_session_scope)
methods.description: Fixture providing a TestClient instance for API calls, ensuring startup/shutdown events run to set up the database appropriately.

methods.name: Callable[[str,str],Tuple[int,str]] register_user_and_get_token(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Factory fixture that registers a user and retrieves an access token via login, returning user ID and token.

methods.name: Callable[[str,str],Dict[str,str]] auth_header(register_user_and_get_token: Callable[[str, str], Tuple[int, str]])
methods.description: Factory fixture that provides authorization headers with a Bearer token for authenticated requests.

methods.name: Callable[[str,str,int],Tuple[int,List[dict]]] seed_tasks(client: TestClient, register_user_and_get_token: Callable[[str, str], Tuple[int, str]])
methods.description: Factory fixture that creates multiple tasks via the API for a user, returning user ID and list of created task data.

methods.name: UserRepository user_repo()
methods.description: Fixture providing an instance of UserRepository.

methods.name: TaskRepository task_repo()
methods.description: Fixture providing an instance of TaskRepository.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[dict]] _seed(email: str, password: str, n: int = 3)
